column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_conv_machine.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Final loading step: sets the counter animation to its idle range (shop_conv_machine_set_counter_anim(0x65)) and stores the loop length of model 0x1020 (shop_conv_machine_get_model, field_3d_get_loop_length) as a float at model +0x20. Returns nothing. Side effects: EHF range, model field. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_load_resources).

Scene state 1 by sub-step 0x00078c22: 0 copies strTbl.bin (resource 0x1030) string 7 into the message buffer 0x00078d02, counts its visible characters (0x00078cfe) and seeds the LCG with 0; 1 after the fade starts the typewriter (flag 0x00079102 bit 0) and sound 0x7a72; 2 and 3 show random counter frames (system_lcg_rand % 100) while the text types, then after 25 frames switch to string 6, rewind slot 1, stop 0x7a72 and play 0x7a64 once; 4 types it; 5 waits for confirm or cancel (pad +4 & 0x6000) and goes to scene state 2. Returns nothing. Side effects: message buffer, timers 0x0007910c, sounds, EHF ranges. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_update).

Copy of the BOOT.BIN generator: advances the current LCG stream as state x 0x41c64e6d + 0x3039 and returns (state & 0x7fffffff) >> 16. Side effects: the stream state. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_run_intro).
Copy of the BOOT.BIN helper: stores state as the seed of the current LCG stream. Side effects: that word. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_run_intro).

Scene state 2: fades out, then opens the card picker in mode 1 (ui_select_card_open(1, {heap 0x00079104, reader 0x00079108, archive 1, archive 2}, &count 0x00078c28, ids 0x00078c2c), flag 0x00079114 bit 0 so the draw entry delegates to ui_select_card_draw) and updates it until it returns 1; after the fade-in, with fewer than 10 cards shows strTbl string 3 and goes to state 7 (ask again); with 10 or more removes every chosen card from the collection (save_change_card_count(id, 0), once per id entry), clears the 2000-byte card record area 0x00079118 and goes to state 3. Returns nothing. Side effects: picker module, save card counts, scene state. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_update).

Scene state 3 (feeding animation): 0 initialises one 0x14-byte record per chosen card at 0x00079118 (+0 x 0, +4 y = step x i + 250.0, +8 20.0, +0xc state 1, +0x10 timer -4 - 3i); 1 moves every record in state 1 for 22 frames (random sound 0x7a65-0x7a68 at its start), then marks it 2; when the last is done rewinds slot 0, sets the machine flag (0x00079114 bits 1-2 = 2) and plays 0x7a6a; 2 waits for that flag to clear; 3 counts the counter animation up to the number of cards (shop_conv_machine_set_counter_anim) and goes to state 4. Returns nothing. Side effects: card records, flags, sounds, EHF ranges. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_update).

Scene state 4 (machine animation) by sub-step: types strTbl string 4, starts the layer animations (shop_conv_machine_set_layer_speed) and sound 0x7a6b, swirls the card records in on a shrinking circle (sceVfpuScalarCos/Sin), runs the machine for 0x150 frames, picks the result (shop_conv_machine_pick_result(count)) into 0x00078cf4, fades a flash (0x00078cf6/0x00078cf7), plays 0x7a6e, 0x7a70 and 0x7a71 while the result card model moves out (0x000798e8-0x000798fc), and ends in scene state 5 with the name slide position 0x00078cfa = 0x1e0. Confirm or cancel during sub-steps 2-7 skips straight to the end (the result is picked at once). Calls shop_conv_machine_play_layer_sounds every frame. Returns nothing. Side effects: result card, records, layers, sounds, scene state. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_update).

Scene state 5: 0 fades the result banner in (0x00079900) and measures the card name (scale fitted to 480 px); 1 slides the name in over 16 frames (0x00078cfa); 2 waits: Triangle (0x1000) fades out and opens the card viewer for the result card (ui_card_viewer_open with resources 0x800c, 0x8012, pack source 0x8015, artwork select; sub-steps 10-12, then back to 2), confirm or cancel adds the card to the collection (save_change_card_count(result, 1)) and goes to 3; 3 slides the result card away, then shows strTbl string 3 and goes to scene state 7 (ask again). Returns nothing. Side effects: save card count, viewer, fades, scene state. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_update).

Tail-jump wrapper (Ghidra shows an empty body; instructions: j system_font_fit_scale_to_width; sll a0, a0, 6): returns system_font_fit_scale_to_width(max_width << 6, text), the horizontal font scale at which text fits max_width pixels (same code as BOOT.BIN system_font_fit_scale_to_width_px). No side effects. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_show_result).

Scene states 6 and 7: sub-step 0 types the message; 1 waits for an answer: in state 7 confirm restarts at scene state 1 and cancel ends, in state 6 the buttons are swapped; ending fades out to black, stops the music (audio_stop_sounds_bgm_arg(600)) and sets scene state 8. Returns nothing. Side effects: scene state, fade, music. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_update).

Returns a random card id from the result pool of count fed cards: the 8-byte record 0x0000b014 + (count - 10) x 8 holds {pointer to a u16 id list, list length}, and the id is list[system_rand_shifted() % length]. No bounds check on count (callers pass 10 or more). No side effects besides the random state. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_run_conversion).

Sets the play range of the counter EHF (resource 0x1013) to show value: frames (value + 1, value + 2); value 0x65 selects frames 0x72-0x95 (idle loop) and 100 frame 0x65. Returns nothing. Side effects: EHF play range. Callers: 3 (shop_conv_machine_run_intro, shop_conv_machine_feed_cards, shop_conv_machine_init_scene).

Animation slot table 0x0000b2e4 (4 bytes per slot: u16 EHF resource id, u16 speed): a non-zero speed is stored; 0 stops the slot and rewinds its EHF to frame 0 (ui_ehf_seek_frame). Returns nothing. Side effects: slot table, EHF state. Callers: 4 (shop_conv_machine_run_conversion, shop_conv_machine_run_intro, shop_conv_machine_feed_cards, shop_conv_machine_select_cards).
Copies the EHF resource id and speed of slot from the table 0x0000b2e4. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_draw_layer_slot).

Returns the duration in update frames of slot's EHF: ui_ehf_get_frame_count / speed, or 0 when the resource is missing or the slot is stopped. No side effects. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_run_conversion).

For the running slots whose EHF is at frame 0 plays their loop sound: slot 1 0x7a6f, slot 6 0x7a6c, slot 7 0x7a6d (ui_ehf_get_current_frame). Returns nothing. Side effects: sounds. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_run_conversion).

Library draw entry of the card conversion machine. While the card picker is active (bit 0 of 0x00079114) it only calls ui_select_card_draw. Otherwise it clears layer 0 to black (colour, stencil, depth) and, when the scene state 0x00078c20 is non-zero: with the card viewer open (bit 4 of 0x00079114) draws only ui_card_viewer_draw; else on layer 1 (texturing, blending, filter, alpha blend 0/2/3) draws the conversion effects (shop_conv_machine_draw_conversion_fx), the background, EHF layer slots 0, 1, 2, 3 and 5, the panel and the message; then the 3D part: shop_conv_machine_begin_3d_frame, matrix mode 2, the machine (shop_conv_machine_draw_machine); in states 4 and 5 the dim overlay on layer 1 when the byte 0x00079900 is non-zero and the result card model (shop_conv_machine_draw_result_card); in state 3 each fed card model (shop_conv_machine_draw_fed_card for the 0x00078c28 records at 0x00079118). On layer 4 it draws, in state 5, the result name at (0x00078cfa, 0xdd) and the hint when bit 2 of 0x00079116 is set, then layer slots 6, 7 and 8; on layer 5 the screen fade (system_draw_fade). Returns nothing. Side effects: GE layers 0, 1, 2, 4, 5. Exported (libconv_machine); module callers via import stubs: rel_story (1: world_state_update_conv_machine); 1 further import stub without callers.

Draws the background texture of resource 0x1001: seven 64 x 256 columns and one 32 x 256 column across the top (x 0 to 0x1df, u = x), then the bottom 16 lines (y 0x100) as four 64 x 16 tiles on each half, placed right to left from 16 x 64 texture strips (u 0x1e0 on the left half, 0x1f0 on the right half, v 0, 0x40, 0x80, 0xc0) with flip_xy 3. Read with the GE setup lines filtered; layout details medium. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_draw).

Draws three 64-px wide strips of the texture of resource 0x1002 side by side at (0x83 + 64 i, 0x5a). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_draw).

Plays one EHF layer slot: reads the slot's resource id and speed from the table 0x0000b2e4 (shop_conv_machine_get_layer_slot); when the speed is non-zero and the resource exists (shop_conv_machine_get_resource), fills a 0x60-byte EHF parameter block (word +0 = the frame-timing word) and draws it between ui_ehf_begin_draw / ui_ehf_end_draw. Speed 1 simply draws the current frame; a larger speed first advances the frame by speed, wrapping modulo (frame count - 1) when it reaches the last frame, and seeks there. Afterwards enables GE state 4 and the usual alpha blend (system_ge_write_blend_func(0, 2, 3, 0, 0)). Returns the advanced display-list pointer (list unchanged when the slot is idle or missing). Side effects: GE commands, EHF frame position. Callers: 2 (ui_conv_machine_draw, shop_conv_machine_draw_layer4_faded).

Draws the machine's message: opens the font list on list, colour 0xff363a21, scale 0xe, and types the UTF-16 buffer 0x00078d02 into the box (0x25, 0x1d, 0x11c, 0x1e) px showing at most the u16 count 0x00078d00 characters (shop_conv_machine_draw_typed_text_px). Unless the scene state 0x00078c20 is 5 it then draws a text cursor after the last character: steadily while bit 0 of 0x00079102 is set, otherwise blinking with bit 3 of the frame counter. The cursor is an untextured rectangle in the font colour, as wide as the first character of strTbl (resource 0x1030) word 7 minus 2 px and one line high, placed at the font end position + 1 px and moved to x 0x25 on the next line when it would pass x 0x141. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: font and GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_draw).

column2: int shop_conv_machine_draw_typed_text_px(int x, int y, int width, int height, ushort *text, int max_glyphs, void *resume)
column3: Pixel wrapper for typewriter text: tail-jumps to system_font_draw_text_box(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, height << 6, text, max_glyphs, resume); the last three arguments travel in t0-t2 and are passed through unchanged (the decompiler shows an empty body). Returns the callee's result. Side effects: text drawn into the open font list. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_draw_message).

Draws the 2D effects of the conversion (scene state 0x00078c20 = 4). (1) When a result card 0x00078cf4 is set: renders its face (ui_draw_card_face) into the off-screen buffer VRAM +0x160000 (128 x 256, psm 3), binds it as texture and draws it as a 6-vertex triangle strip (system_ge_draw_array prim 4, vertex type 0x80019f: float uv, colour, float xyz; 0x90 bytes of inline data) built from the template 0x0000b308 (6 x 16 bytes: x and y in a 108 x 154 frame, u, v): the card grows with the byte 0x00078cf7 (up to 0x80: 78 x 112 px centred in the box at (0x83, 0x5a) of size 0xb9 x 0x8d) with alpha byte 0x00078cf6; above 0x80 vertices 0-1 and 4-5 are pushed apart vertically and 2-3 horizontally in proportion to (value - 0x80). (2) Steps the layer fade: mode bits 0-1 of 0x00079116 = 1 raise the alpha byte 0x00079115 by 4 up to 0xff, = 2 lower it by 8 down to 0, clearing the mode at the end; then draws layer slot 4 with that alpha (shop_conv_machine_draw_layer4_faded). (3) In state 4, for each of the 0x00078c28 fed-card records (0x14 bytes at 0x00079118: +0 x, +4 y floats, +0xc state, +0x10 timer) in state 3 with timer t > 0, renders that card's face (u16 ids at 0x00078c2c) and draws it as a sprite (texture 0x6c x 0x9a) of (21 - t)^2 x 78 / 441 by (21 - t)^2 x 112 / 441 px, alpha (21 - t) x 255 / 21, centred on (x + 220, y + 160). Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands, VRAM, the fade bytes 0x00079115/0x00079116. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_draw).

Draws EHF layer slot 4 with a global alpha: alpha 0 draws nothing; 0xff draws the slot directly (shop_conv_machine_draw_layer_slot(list, 4)); other values render it off screen (render target VRAM +0x174000, 512 x 512, psm 3, first cleared with an opaque black 0x1e0 x 0x110 quad), bind the back buffer again and draw that buffer as one textured 0x1e0 x 0x110 sprite with ambient colour alpha << 24 | 0xffffff, so the whole layer fades as one image. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands, VRAM. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_draw_conversion_fx).

Darkens the screen: disables GE states 1 and 9 (texturing), draws an untextured 0x1e0 x 0x110 sprite at (0, 0) in black with alpha (ambient colour alpha << 24), then re-enables state 9, restores the texture function and white ambient and re-enables state 1. Returns the advanced display-list pointer. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_draw, with the banner byte 0x00079900 in scene states 4 and 5).

column2: void shop_conv_machine_draw_result_name(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Draws the result card's name (card_db_get_name of 0x00078cf4) with the font shadow off five times around (x + 1, y + 1) to form an outline (ui_window_draw_text_px, width 0x1e0; the colours are set between the calls), then re-enables the shadow. Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_draw).

column2: void ui_window_draw_text_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Copy of the BOOT.BIN pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text), text passed through in its register. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_draw_result_name).

Draws strTbl.bin (resource 0x1030) string 5 right-aligned to x 0x1dc and bottom-aligned to y 0x10c (font units 0x7700 / 0x4300 minus its size). Returns nothing. Side effects: font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_draw).

Prepares the 3D scene: field_3d_init_render_state on layer 0, field_3d_set_allocator(shop_conv_machine_heap_alloc, shop_conv_machine_heap_free), two light records 0x0000bb90 / 0x0000bbcc (0x3c bytes: ambient 0xff000000, diffuse white / 0xff404040), lighting on, perspective (near 30.0, far 300.0) and identity view and model matrices, then commits the layer. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE state, field_3d allocator, light records, matrices. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_start).
Copy of the BOOT.BIN helper: copies three floats from src to dest and returns dest. Side effects: writes dest[0..2]. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_init_3d).

On layer 2 installs lights 0 and 1 (field_3d_set_light with 0x0000bb90 / 0x0000bbcc), enables lighting and both lights with a black ambient, commits, sets camera 0 (shop_conv_machine_set_camera) and resets the model matrix. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE state, matrices. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_draw).

Animates and draws the machine model 0x1020 (shop_conv_machine_get_model) on layer 2 with lighting and camera 1 (shop_conv_machine_set_camera). The animation direction comes from bits 1-2 of the flag byte 0x00079114: 2 plays forward (step 1.0) and, when the frame +0x20 reaches field_3d_get_loop_length, clamps it there and clears bits 1-3; 1 plays backward (step -1.0) and, when the frame drops below 0, sets it to 0, clears bits 1-2 and sets bit 3; 0 holds the frame (step 0). The model is drawn with field_3d_draw_model and a 0x34-byte hook {2, 2, 0...}. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE layer 2, GU matrix mode 2, model frame, flag byte 0x00079114. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_draw).

For a card record in state 1 with a started timer, draws model 0x1021 (a card) with lighting off and camera 2: model matrix = translate(record +0, +4, +8) and a fixed X rotation; field_3d_exchange_draw_state, field_3d_update_model, field_3d_draw_model with draw flags {2, 3}. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands, model state. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_draw).

When the result card is shown (0x000798f4), draws model 0x1021 with camera 3 at (0x000798e8, 0x000798ec, 0x000798f0), rotated about Y by a constant and about X and Z by the spin angles 0x000798f8 / 0x000798fc, with the draw-state callback shop_conv_machine_render_card_face so the model shows the result card's face. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands, model state. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_draw).

Allocator callback: tail-jumps to system_heap_alloc(*(0x00079104), size), the module heap. Returns the block (passed through). Side effects: heap allocation. No direct caller (handed to field_3d_set_allocator by shop_conv_machine_init_3d).

Free callback: tail-jumps to system_heap_free(*(0x00079104), ptr) on the module heap. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap. No direct caller (handed to field_3d_set_allocator by shop_conv_machine_init_3d).

Draw-state callback of the result card model: for pass 0 or 1 enables texturing and alpha blending, renders the card face of the result card (ui_draw_card_face(list, 0, 0, id), pass 0 only) into an off-screen 128 x 256 target at VRAM + 0x160000 (system_ge_set_render_targets), rebinds the back buffer and selects that area as the model's texture (format 3, 128 x 256, offset and scale fitted to the card face). Returns 1 for passes 0 and 1, else 0. Side effects: GE commands, VRAM. No direct caller (callback given to field_3d_exchange_draw_state).

Loads camera index from the 0x30-byte records at 0x0000b380: projection = translate(record) x perspective(fov record +0xc degrees, aspect, near +0x10, far +0x14), view = field_3d_camera_set_look_at(record +0x20, fixed target and up vectors 0x0000b440 / 0x0000b450), and marks the matrices dirty. Returns nothing. Side effects: GU matrices. Callers: 4 (shop_conv_machine_draw_fed_card, shop_conv_machine_draw_result_card, shop_conv_machine_begin_3d_frame, shop_conv_machine_draw_machine).
Copy of the BOOT.BIN comparator: returns *a - *b. No side effects. No direct caller (qsort callback of shop_conv_machine_init_resources).

column2: int ui_deck_find_resource(ushort id, void *table, int count)
column3: Copy of rel_deck's binary search of count 12-byte resource records by u16 id. Returns the index or -1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (shop_conv_machine_get_resource).

Clears the loader byte 0x0000bc10 and sets bit 0 (idle), then sorts the resource tables: 0x29 records of 12 bytes at 0x0000b740 (ids 0x8xxx, deck_compare_u16_ascending), 12 records of 16 bytes at 0x0000ba44 (ids 0x1xxx) and 2 records of 20 bytes at 0x0000bb44 (3D models), the last two with shop_conv_machine_compare_u16. Returns nothing. Side effects: 0x0000bc10, tables. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_start).

Stepped loader (bits 1-7 of 0x0000bc10, waiting while bit 0 is clear): 0 opens the card-image reader (card_db_open_cardh_cip on the 0x6d000-byte buffer 0x0000bc14, stored in 0x00079108) and starts archive 2; 1 starts archive 1; 2 waits for card_db_cip_is_ready; 3 loads module 0x1d (rel_select_card, system_module_load); 4 waits for system_module_all_loaded and records 0x1d in 0x00079110; 5 runs shop_conv_machine_init_scene and returns 1. Returns 0 while loading. Side effects: reader, archives, module load. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_update).

Returns the data of archive id (2 records of 12 bytes at 0x0000b488: u16 id, pointer, path format) when loaded; otherwise, when no load is pending, formats the path with the language letter ("jegfis"), allocates the file size from the module heap *0x00079104 and starts container_load_file(3, path, buffer, size, shop_on_archive_loaded, buffer). Returns 0 while not loaded. Side effects: heap, archive record, loader byte. Callers: 4 (shop_conv_machine_get_resource, shop_conv_machine_get_model, shop_conv_machine_load_resources, shop_conv_machine_select_cards).

Resource lookup: ids with bit 15 search the 0x29 12-byte records at 0x0000b740 (archive 1; member-name format with the language letter, a fixed letter for 0x8036/0x8037), ids with bit 12 the 12 16-byte records at 0x0000ba44 (archive 2, e.g. a background GIM member); the member pointer (container_ehp_find_member) is cached in the record. Returns it, or 0. Side effects: record caches, archive loads. Callers: 13 (shop_conv_machine_draw_layer_slot, shop_conv_machine_set_layer_speed, shop_conv_machine_select_cards, shop_conv_machine_draw_hint, ...).

Returns the cached 3D model instance of id from the two 20-byte records at 0x0000bb44 {u16 id, instance, TMS member name, TMT member name, TMA member name}; on first use (archive 2 loaded) finds the members and creates the instance (field_3d_create_model_instance with the TMT texture set, or field_3d_set_animation when the second member starts with 'TGMT'), and attaches the TMA animation (field_3d_set_tma). Returns the instance or 0. Side effects: model creation, record cache. Callers: 4 (shop_conv_machine_draw_fed_card, shop_conv_machine_draw_result_card, shop_conv_machine_init_scene, shop_conv_machine_draw_machine).

Copy of rel_shop's load callback: when size > 0 binds the EHP (container_ehp_bind_with_callback) and advances the loader byte 0x0000bc10. Returns size > 0. Side effects: binding, loader byte. No direct caller (container_load_file callback).
Comparator returning *a - *b (same code as deck_compare_u16_ascending at 0x00003e20). No side effects. No direct caller (qsort callback of shop_conv_machine_init_resources).

column2: int shop_bsearch_resource_table(ushort id, void *table, int count, int entry_size)
column3: Copy of rel_shop's binary search of id in count entries of entry_size bytes sorted by u16 id. Returns the index or -1. No side effects. Callers: 2 (shop_conv_machine_get_model, shop_conv_machine_get_resource).
Module entry point of rel_conv_machine (ELF e_entry 0x467c), with nothing to do. Returns 0 at once. No side effects. No direct caller (run by the module loader through e_entry).

Library start of the conversion machine: clears the 0xce4-byte state at 0x00078c20, creates a 0x600000-byte heap at 0x00079910 (pointer 0x00079104), sets the VFPU thread attribute, prepares the 3D scene (shop_conv_machine_init_3d) and the resource tables (shop_conv_machine_init_resources), releases the low sound banks and loads track 0x2ce, enables font shadow and colour codes and sets wrapping by language. Returns nothing. Side effects: module state, heap, audio, font settings. Exported (libconv_machine_rel); module callers via import stubs: rel_story (world_state_start_conv_machine), rel_labo (0x00000034).

Library update: dispatches on the scene state 0x00078c20: 0 loading (shop_conv_machine_load_resources; then fade-in, track 4, loading overlay off, state 1), 1 intro, 2 card selection, 3 feeding, 4 conversion, 5 result, 6/7 ask again, 8 waits for the fade-out, 9 shutdown (shop_conv_machine_shutdown). Returns 1 when the shutdown has finished, else 0. Side effects: those of the handlers. Exported (libconv_machine_rel); module callers via import stubs: rel_story (world_state_update_conv_machine), rel_labo (0x00000034).

Shutdown stepped by 0x00078c24: 0 waits until no sound effect or voice plays, then releases track 0x2ce; 1 closes the card view, asks the reader to stop (card_db_cip_request_stop), unloads module 0x1d when it was loaded and frees the heap (system_free_aligned); 2 returns 1 once the reader is idle. Returns 1 when finished, else 0. Side effects: audio, card view, reader, module unload, heap. Callers: 1 (ui_conv_machine_update).
